title: Other bands: Kid Clayton, George Williams and old Willie Humphrey
summary: French mentions working with Kid Clayton, George Williams, and the old Willie Humphrey band.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Let's see. Are there any other bands that we've skipped in there that you played with?

Well, maybe one. I played with Kit Clayton. He might have heard that. Oh yeah sure I know Kit Clayton. I worked with Kit Clayton. And from Kit Clayton, I worked with George Williams. You heard of George Williams? The drummer? Drummer, yeah. He used to be the paddock. That's right. And I worked with Percy Alfred band too. At the time the old man had the band. Percy Daddy.
Old Willie Alfred. Yeah I worked with his band.
We interviewed him too. He's still running.
He's still running. He's still running.
His mind was clear and all when we talked to him about a year ago. I haven't seen him since.
